# pbakaus Vendor Skills

Third-party skills from https://github.com/pbakaus/impeccable

## Impeccable

**Installed:** 2026-04-29  
**Upstream source:** `.claude/skills/impeccable/` from https://github.com/pbakaus/impeccable  
**License:** Apache 2.0 (see NOTICE.md in upstream repo)

### Purpose in brain repo

Tactical frontend polish, anti-slop detection, audits, hardening, live visual iteration, and command-driven refinement.

**Role:** Does NOT own persistent brand truth. Must read and respect `DESIGN.md` and `brand-spec.md` when present. Acts as a polishing and iteration layer on top of the existing design stack.

### Commands

- `craft` — Shape and build a feature end-to-end
- `shape` — Plan UX/UI before writing code
- `teach` — Set up PRODUCT.md and DESIGN.md context
- `document` — Generate DESIGN.md from existing project code
- `audit` — Technical quality checks (a11y, perf, responsive)
- `critique` — UX design review with heuristic scoring
- `polish` — Final quality pass before shipping
- `bolder`, `quieter`, `distill`, `typeset`, `layout`, `colorize`, `animate`, `delight`, `overdrive` — Targeted visual transformations
- `harden`, `onboard`, `optimize`, `clarify`, `adapt` — Production-ready fixes
- `extract` — Pull reusable tokens and components
- `live` — Browser/live visual variant iteration

### Non-overlap boundaries

- Does **not** replace `/design-system` — does not own persistent brand truth
- Does **not** replace `/web-design` — does not produce implementation-ready specs
- Does **not** replace `/huashu-design` — does not produce decks, prototypes, or export artifacts (unless tactical polish on existing work)
- Does **not** replace `/redesign-skill` — does not handle safe codebase-wide redesign (though may complement it)
- **Does** work as a tactical layer on top of the current design stack
